capabilities.text: Allow a nurse to type a patient note once and save it to both the electronic health record system (CareCom) and print a copy for the ward flow sheet
Display a list of patients assigned to the nurse's ward, including patient names, bed numbers, and last note date/time
Provide a clean, simple text box for note entry with an automatically filled timestamp
Include a 'Save and Print' button that saves the note and triggers printing of the ward flow sheet copy
Lock notes after saving so they cannot be edited; corrections must be added as new notes
Allow nurses to view a patient's full note history sorted by date and time, including notes from all nurses on the ward
Restrict patient list and note history access to only patients on the nurse's assigned ward
Block saving of empty or whitespace-only notes and display a clear message prompting the nurse to type a note before saving
Provide clear confirmation messages after saving: green message for successful save and print, and distinct messages for print failure or save failure
If printing fails, notify the nurse with a clear message, allow retrying or manual printing, and ensure the note is still saved to CareCom
If saving to CareCom fails (e.g., network issues), keep the note on screen and saved locally, show a clear error message, and provide a retry option
Prevent the nurse from exiting the note entry screen with unsaved notes unless they deliberately remove the note
Run the tool on tablets via a web browser, compatible with hospital network login and tolerant of slow Wi-Fi
Automatically use the nurse's hospital tablet login identity for authentication without requiring additional password entry
Support up to 60 concurrent nurse users across three wards without performance degradation
Encrypt all health data in transit and at rest, maintain access logs, and restrict access to authorized nursing staff only, ensuring compliance with UK GDPR and NHS data security standards
Populate the patient list daily from the hospital’s master patient list filtered by ward assignment
Allow nurses to add free-text notes without mandatory fields or categories, with only an automatic timestamp added
Provide clear, immediate feedback on all user actions without pop-ups or extra steps, keeping the interface simple and fast
